title: Specialty Drug Monitoring Visits on Standing Referrals — Primary Care Provider Assignment
content:
Pharmacy liaison note for the **Primary Care Provider Assignment**: monitoring visits on a standing referral for a member on specialty drug therapy.

**Rule.** Monitoring visits are added to a standing referral's allowance for specialty drug therapy, before the standing-referral visit ceiling is applied. They are counted as the member's paid specialty-tier pharmacy fills under the **Pharmacy Benefit** — fills whose formulary status is specialty — with a fill date in the monitoring window of **3 months**:

- at least **3** such fills (the many-fills count) add the larger monitoring allowance of **4** visits;
- at least 1 fill but fewer than 3 add the smaller monitoring allowance of **2** visits;
- no such fill adds nothing.

The monitoring window is a trailing period counted back from the handling date in whole months: a fill is inside it when fewer than 3 whole months separate its fill date from the handling date, so a fill dated exactly 3 months back is outside it.

| Paid specialty-tier fills in the last 3 months | Monitoring visits added |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0 |
| 1 | 2 |
| 2 | 2 |
| 3 | 4 |
| 5 | 4 |

**Examples (hypothetical, handling date 15 September 2026)**

- Specialty-tier fills on 20 June, 18 July and 17 August 2026: three in the window, 4 monitoring visits.
- Specialty-tier fills on 15 June and 17 August 2026: 15 June is exactly 3 months back and outside, leaving one fill: 2 monitoring visits.
- Fills in the last 3 months, all of preferred generic drugs: no specialty-tier fill, no monitoring visit.
